say:7:1610101105:1.text: This is the most mysterious part! Chippy woke up to find the letter stuck in the crack of our door. Chippy is a light sleeper and would've known if someone came by.
say:7:1610101105:1.source_cn: 这就是最神秘的地方！满满一觉睡醒就看到这封信插在神秘屋...
